evals.prompt: I have a hedera-harness clone open. Help me create a Tier 0-1 harness spec for an HCS proof-wall demo called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity. Default seed.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that asks one question at a time with a recommended answer, looks up harness facts, waits for shared understanding before writing files, then emits a coherent gate 0-1 spec under docs/prds/proof-wall.md, specs/proof-wall.yaml, validators/proof-wall-static.json, validators/proof-wall-yarn.json.
assertions: The output satisfies: Follows grilling protocol: one question at a time / recommended answer
The output satisfies: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed
The output includes validators.static: Spec file includes validators.static (harness loader field)
The output includes templateMetadata: Spec file includes templateMetadata (harness loader field)
The output satisfies: Command validator has a command literally named install
The output includes hedera-consensus-service: Recommends generator skill hedera-consensus-service for HCS
The output satisfies: Keeps the run blind / separates PRD from oracle
The output satisfies: States that authoring skills stay out of the generator skills list

evals.prompt: I already scaffolded a Scaffold HBAR hedera-demo app (packages/nextjs present). Help me create an in-place project harness spec under .harness/ for adding a public Learn page. No Solidity. Gate 0-1 only.
evals.expected_output: A grilling session that picks project layout, waits for shared understanding, then emits .harness/prd.md, .harness/spec.yaml (no seed, with extend.baseline), .harness/validators/static.json, .harness/validators/yarn.json, and hands off yarn harness:run or hedera-harness run.
assertions: The output satisfies: Chooses project / .harness layout
The output satisfies: Does not write files until shared understanding is confirmed
The output satisfies: Emits files under .harness/
The output includes extend.baseline: Mentions or includes extend.baseline
The output satisfies: Notes that project layout has no seed
The output satisfies: Hands off to run CLI / yarn script

evals.prompt: Deepen my existing proof-wall harness spec to gate 3. Derive acceptance contract assertions from the PRD journeys (browse without wallet; wallet-gated post). Keep the run blind.
evals.expected_output: An oracle with C1/C2/... assertions, evaluationRules fail-closed posture, and instructions to uncomment contract + validator in the spec file — without mirroring assertion text into the PRD.
assertions: The output includes "id": "C1": Oracle uses numbered assertion ids starting at C1
The output includes howToVerify: Assertions include howToVerify
The output includes executableWithTestSigner: Mentions or uses executableWithTestSigner (loader/grader field)
The output includes failOnUncertainty: evaluationRules include failOnUncertainty
The output satisfies: Reminds that oracle text must not go into the PRD

evals.prompt: When should I enable chainValidation for my harness spec, and what YAML fields do I need?
evals.expected_output: Guidance that gate 3.5 is opt-in, requires gate 3, network testnet, operator env vars, and executableWithTestSigner assertions.
assertions: The output includes chainValidation: References chainValidation block
The output includes network: testnet: Specifies chainValidation.network testnet
The output satisfies: Mentions operator env var names
The output includes executableWithTestSigner: Ties on-chain grading to executableWithTestSigner
